# `browser-tab copy`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab copy [FLAGS]`

Reconstruct selected tabs at a destination; sources stay open (needs daemon)

## Flags

### `--selector <json>`

Selector AST as JSON; @<file> or - for stdin

### `--selection <id>`

A current select_tabs selectionId (instead of --selector)

### `--to-window <windowId>`

Copy into an existing window

### `--new-window <browser>`

Copy into a new window in this browser

### `--idempotency-key <key>`

Retry-safe: same key replays the stored outcome
